responsibilities: Own the new platform's data quality end to end, vertical by vertical.
Bring a business and vertical lens to how the platform's data is modelled, working with analytics and data engineers
Check that reports and metrics built on the data are accurate and give the business what it needs
Build and change dbt models yourself, and work alongside analytics engineers on the core platform models
Coordinate data impact assessments across squads, from agreeing test scenarios to verifying results in Snowflake
Make the method scale across multiple squads so it doesn't depend on any one person
Partner early with platform engineers and Technical Product Owners to guide modelling before things are built
Identify where the platform's event-driven data can unlock new value beyond legacy reporting
Support the platform's Technical Product Owners with insights and analysis to track rollout success
Learn each vertical alongside our Insights Analysts and share what you learn

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Own the new platform's data quality end to end, vertical by vertical.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Data quality ownership, accuracy checks and test scenarios dominate; the only velocity cue is "stays pragmatic about scale", so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: the reports the business relies on
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Marketplace data quality affects business decisions without regulatory or financial-reporting language, so moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Insights Analysts; data engineers; platform engineers; Technical Product Owners; software engineers
evidence.data_team_maturity: Sitting day-to-day with our Insights Analysts and reporting into the Data Platform squad
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Distinct Insights Analyst, analytics engineer and Data Platform squad functions operating across multiple squads indicate an established, specialised data organisation.
evidence.jd_authorship: Coordinate data impact assessments across squads, from agreeing test scenarios to verifying results in Snowflake
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Specific activities (impact assessments, test scenarios, verifying in Snowflake, dbt models) make the work clear.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Partner early with platform engineers and Technical Product Owners to guide modelling before things are built
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Audience mixes platform product owners and engineers with the insights analysts consuming the data, with no single dominant group.
evidence.autonomy_level: Make the method scale across multiple squads so it doesn't depend on any one person
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: "Own the new platform's data quality end to end" and designing the method are strategic ownership verbs.
evidence.ai_role: An AI-first way of working, using AI-assisted development (Claude Code) daily
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to use Claude Code daily to accelerate their own work.
evidence.testing_framing: A track record owning data quality or testing outcomes across teams, including defining test scenarios and verifying results
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality and test scenarios are owned and defined by the candidate.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: you'll own the quality of the new platform's data end to end, from how it's modelled and generated to the reports the business relies on
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Data quality and accuracy ownership frames the role summary and first responsibility, reflecting fear of incorrect data during a platform migration.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Trade Me is moving key parts of our business onto a new modular platform.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role builds models for a new platform while verifying and changing existing data, mixing build and migration.
evidence.work_arrangement: come together in person on Monday and at least one other day a week
